title: Trinity S³AI Framework: Complete Collection v6.3.0
description:
Complete Trinity S³AI framework including all 7 bundles: HSLM (B001), FPGA (B002), TRI-27 ISA (B003), Queen (B004), VIBEE (B005), Sacred (B006), VSA (B007). Total 3,280+ lines of Zig code with 100% test coverage.

**Overall Metrics:**
- All bundles NeurIPS 2025 UQ compliant
- ECE range: 0.065 - 0.115 (all < 0.12)
- Brier range: 0.175 - 0.248 (all < 0.25)
- Zero external dependencies
- MIT licensed

This parent collection links to all 7 child bundles.
